test.create_query: CREATE TABLE has_any_chain (tags Array(String), ids Array(UInt32)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO has_any_chain SELECT arrayMap(x -> toString(cityHash64(number, x) % 1000), range(number % 20)), arrayMap(x -> 100000 + if(x = 0, number % 10, cityHash64(number, x) % 100000), range(number % 20)) FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM has_any_chain WHERE hasAny(tags, ['1', '2', '3']) OR hasAny(tags, ['4', '5', '6']) OR hasAny(tags, ['7', '8', '9'])
